function.name: get_detail_adriel_project
function.description: Retrieve the detailed information of a specific project that Adriel worked on, including its current status and relevant dates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_name.description: The unique name of the project.

include_financials.description: A flag to indicate whether financial details should be included in the response.

status_filter.description: Filter the details by the current status of the project.

function.name: get_adriel_list_projects
function.description: Retrieve a list of projects that Adriel is currently involved in, including active and inactive projects. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the project list is being retrieved.

include_inactive.description: A flag to determine whether to include inactive projects in the list.

sort_order.description: The order in which the list of projects is sorted. It can be either by 'start_date' or 'name'.

function.name: get_adriel_experiences
function.description: Retrieves a list of Adriel's professional experiences, including roles and companies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose experiences are being fetched.

include_education.description: A flag to determine if educational experiences should be included.

years.description: Filter the experiences to only include those within the last specified number of years.

sort_order.description: The order in which to sort the experiences, either by start date or relevance.

function.name: get_adriel_education
function.description: Retrieve the educational background information for an individual named Adriel, including the institutions attended, degrees earned, and years of attendance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

person_id.description: The unique identifier for the person whose educational background is being requested. This should be in the format of a UUID.

include_certifications.description: A flag to determine whether to include certifications along with formal education.

fields.description: An array of strings specifying which fields of the educational background to include in the response, such as ['institution', 'degree', 'year'].
